result.description:
Global Vision Recruitment on Behalf of Loginet Technologies Pty Ltd

Date Posted: 13th July 2026

Position: ICT Project Manager (ANZSCO 135112)

Salary: $100,000 – $125,000 per annum plus Superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-Time, Permanent

Location: 217 Margaret St, Toowoomba City QLD 4350

Experience required: Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects

About Loginet Technologies

Loginet Technologies is an Australian technology consulting and digital transformation company committed to helping businesses leverage innovative technologies to improve efficiency, productivity, and sustainable growth. We deliver end-to-end ICT solutions across managed IT services, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software and mobile application development, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent business automation, DevOps, enterprise networking, telecommunications, digital transformation, infrastructure management, ERP and CRM solutions, and managed technology support. Our experienced team works closely with organisations across diverse industries to design, implement, integrate, and support secure, scalable, and future-ready technology solutions that drive business innovation and operational excellence.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced ICT Project Manager to lead the successful planning, execution and delivery of complex ICT projects across software development, AI solutions, business automation, cloud services, cybersecurity and digital transformation initiatives.

Working closely with clients, business stakeholders and multidisciplinary technical teams, you will manage the complete project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the complete lifecycle of ICT projects from initiation through planning, execution, implementation and closure.

•	Lead software development, cloud migration, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent automation and digital transformation projects.

•	Collaborate with clients to gather business requirements and translate them into successful project outcomes.

•	Develop project plans, budgets, schedules, milestones and resource allocation plans.

•	Coordinate cross-functional teams including software developers, AI engineers, cloud architects, infrastructure engineers, business analysts and cybersecurity specialists.

•	Manage Agile, Scrum and hybrid project delivery methodologies.

•	Monitor project progress, budgets, risks, issues and quality standards while ensuring successful project delivery.

•	Facilitate project workshops, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, stakeholder meetings and executive reporting.

•	Manage project governance, change requests, risk mitigation and quality assurance activities.

•	Coordinate with third-party vendors and technology partners to support successful project implementation.

•	Ensure successful deployment, client acceptance, knowledge transfer and operational handover following project completion.

•	Continuously improve project management processes and delivery frameworks across the organisation.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

•	Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a closely related ICT discipline.

•	Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects.

•	Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise software, cloud, infrastructure or digital transformation projects.

•	Experience managing Agile and Scrum software development projects.

•	Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

•	Excellent leadership, communication and organisational abilities.

•	Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks and multidisciplinary project teams.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Skills

•	Experience delivering AI, Generative AI or intelligent automation projects.

•	Experience with workflow automation platforms including n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make.com or similar technologies.

•	Knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.

•	Understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise networking and managed IT services.

•	Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, Trello, Monday.com or similar project management platforms.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

Why Join Loginet Technologies?

At Loginet Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects involving Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, intelligent automation, cloud computing, cybersecurity and digital transformation. We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their technical expertise, contribute to meaningful client outcomes and build long-term careers within a growing Australian technology company.

We offer:

•	Competitive remuneration package

•	Ongoing professional development and certification support

•	Flexible working arrangements

•	Exposure to enterprise cloud, AI and digital transformation projects

•	Career progression opportunities

•	Supportive and collaborative team culture

Interested applicant may submit their application to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.
result.title: ICT Project Manager

result.description: Boram Tiling Pty Ltd   Construction Estimator    Boram Tiling Pty Ltd    Position: Full-time, permanent (38 hours per week)       Salary: $90,000 - $95,000 base salary + Superannuation    Location: Strathfield NSW 2135    About the Role   We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our pre-construction team on a permanent full-time basis. The successful applicant will play a key role in preparing accurate cost estimates and competitive tenders for commercial and residential construction projects, with a particular focus on tiling and waterproofing trade packages.  Reporting to the Director, you will work closely with project managers, suppliers, subcontractors and clients to ensure accurate pricing and successful tender submissions.   How to apply   Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant construction estimating experience and suitability for the role. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities    Prepare detailed cost estimates and quantity take-offs for commercial and residential construction projects, particularly tiling and waterproofing trade packages.  Analyse project conditions, trade scopes, installation requirements and site factors to determine labour, material, equipment and preliminary costs.  Measure quantities and prepare material take-offs using estimating software such as Bluebeam and Cubit Estimating.  Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings, specifications and contract documentation.  Liaise with builders, suppliers, subcontractors and internal project teams to obtain quotations and technical information.  Conduct site inspections where required to verify measurements, access conditions and installation requirements.  Prepare pricing schedules, cost breakdowns, estimate summaries and tender submissions.  Assist with compiling tender documentation and supporting estimate analyses.  Participate in tender clarification meetings and respond to pricing queries.  Ensure estimates are commercially competitive while complying with project specifications and contractual requirements.       Qualification & experience   Requirements    Must have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Building and Construction Estimating, or Quantity Surveying.  At least 3 years of relevant fulltime experience as a construction estimator.  Demonstrated experience preparing estimates for commercial or residential construction projects.   Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings and specifications.   Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills.   Experience using construction estimating software and Microsoft Excel.   Excellent communication and organisational skills with strong attention to detail.   Ability to manage multiple tenders and work effectively within deadlines.   Previous experience estimating tiling, waterproofing or specialist finishes packages will be highly regarded.   About Company     About Us  Boram Tiling Pty Ltd (ABN 42 610 627 364) is one of New South Wales' leading commercial tiling and waterproofing contractors, delivering high-quality solutions across residential, commercial and mixed-use construction projects. Since its establishment, the company has built a strong reputation for professionalism, reliability and exceptional workmanship, becoming the preferred contractor for many builders and developers throughout NSW.  Our expertise spans ceramic tiling and waterproofing, with comprehensive supply and installation services tailored to meet the needs of complex construction projects. We pride ourselves on delivering projects to the highest quality standards while maintaining strong, long-term relationships with our clients through dependable service and consistent results.         Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $90000-95000   Job Publish:  21-07-2026   Job Expire:  20-08-2026  Apply on:  Construction Estimator Job here! As our project workload and client base continue to grow, we are seeking a dedicated Contract Administrator to manage the contractual and administrative side of our testing services. persons affected  Managing paperwork associated with contracts, programs, projects and services provided  Working with project managers, builders, engineers and other stakeholders to ensure project goals are met  Advising senior management on matters requiring attention and assisting in implementing decisions  Overseeing work undertaken by contractors and reporting on variations to work orders  Preparing and reviewing submissions and reports concerning the organisation's activities  Collecting and analysing data associated with projects undertaken, and reporting on project outcomes    Qualification & experience   Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in contract administration, construction administration, or a similar role  Tertiary qualification in business, commerce, construction management, or a related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience)  Strong organisational and communication skills  Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)  Ability to liaise effectively with contractors, project stakeholders, and senior management  Sound understanding of contract documentation and compliance requirements   About Company     SBDC Testing is a trusted provider of concrete testing services, established in 2014 and operating across Australia. With a strong focus on accuracy, reliability, and integrity, SBDC has built a reputation for delivering high-quality testing solutions that support the successful delivery of major infrastructure and construction projects.    Our team works closely with builders, concrete suppliers, and engineers to ensure every aspect of testing is carried out in strict accordance with Australian Standards, providing confidence that all materials meet required specifications.    At SBDC Testing, we pride ourselves on being responsive, professional, and solutions focused. Our commitment is simple: accurate, timely and dependable testing that helps clients minimise risk, maintain compliance, and deliver projects with confidence.
